speaks_to: You are an MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenAI Agents SDK with MCP, Strands, any MCP runtime) calling tools on an x402-capable bridge MCP server (Polygon LLM Wallet MCP, Coinbase MCP). Read this before repeated paid tool calls.

wallet_capability.wallet_type: x402 embedded wallet inside the bridge MCP server (Polygon LLM Wallet MCP / CDP MCP server)

payment_call_mechanism.how_agent_calls_paid_tools: You call a tool on the MCP server; the server makes the HTTP request to the paid API; on 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED the server uses an x402-axios wrapper to sign USDC from its embedded wallet, retries with X-PAYMENT, and returns data. OpenAI Agents SDK surfaces failure_error_function for failures and drop_failed_servers for connection handling.
payment_call_mechanism.payment_auth_method: wallet private key in MCP server config

expected_x402_flow: MCP client calls a tool on the MCP server
MCP server makes the HTTP request to the paid API endpoint
MCP server signs USDC via x402-axios from its embedded wallet
On 200: data returned to the MCP client; on failure: failure_error_function surfaces a structured error to the model

spend_policy_assumptions.note: The bridge MCP wallet typically has NO session-level spend cap. Each tool call can trigger a fresh 402 → pay → return, so an FM-01 loop accumulates spend with nothing to stop it. This is the most common reported production incident for this stack.

primary_failure_mode.description: You call the MCP tool repeatedly; each call triggers a 402 → payment → return cycle. With no session-level cap on the MCP server wallet, spend accumulates with no exit condition.
primary_failure_mode.payment_consequence: Wallet drains with no corresponding task completion; the model may not even register that each retry cost money.

observable_trigger_signals.signal: failed_servers list populated; connection error on the wallet MCP server
Repeated identical tool invocations with incrementally different arguments
Payment count spikes with no corresponding task completion

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: you see repeated identical tool calls / payment count climbing without progress
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: loop diagnosis + exit guidance before more spend

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: you sense failure but cannot classify it
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: distress_class (loop_detected / schema_mismatch / tool_failure) + next pack + escalate_if

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: the wallet MCP server is in failed_servers / connection refused
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: MCP wiring diagnosis for the down/misconfigured server

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: the paid MCP server is not in your registry/discovery set
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: Bazaar index check for the missing paid endpoint

priority_rationale: MCP is becoming the universal tool protocol; every LLM front-end attaches MCP servers and payment-capable MCP is the fastest-growing surface. The FM-01 loop with uncapped spend is the most common production incident reported for this category.
source_brief: Second Eyes Agent Lounge — Wallet-Equipped Agent Target Map (research June 2025)
